decisions.optimizers: fresh AdamW for policy and critic: the supplied bundle has no optimizer state (deviation)
decisions.critic_optimizer: AdamW groups from common.models.value_parameter_groups (LoRA value_lora_learning_rate, head value_head_learning_rate), weight_decay=0, no scheduler
decisions.loss: policy: task2_ppo.ppo.ppo_policy_loss; critic: value_coef * task2_ppo.ppo.value_mse_loss; separate optimizers, separate grad clipping at max_grad_norm (norms logged before clipping)
decisions.micro_batching: one response per forward/backward; each micro-batch loss multiplied by its valid-token share so the accumulated gradient is the token mean over the update
decisions.advantages: GAE (task2_ppo.ppo.compute_gae) on KL-shaped rewards (task2_ppo.ppo.shaped_rewards) with old/ref log-probs, terminal reward = RM raw - missing_eos_penalty if no EOS; returns = A + V; no whitening
decisions.values: V(s_t) read at the position predicting response token t (same shift as the log-probs); values on padding zeroed so V after the last valid token is 0
decisions.reference: same policy with the LoRA adapter disabled (common.models.reference_mode) = base_model
decisions.dropout: p set to 0 on every torch.nn.Dropout of the trainable policy and critic (LoRA dropout 0.05 inactive)
decisions.critic_dtype: critic LoRA float32 (PEFT), critic head cast to float32 with a float32 input cast; frozen base float16
decisions.log_probs: teacher-forced, temperature 1 (common.generation.response_token_logprobs); sampling uses the generation settings
decisions.kl_and_entropy: common.metrics.sampled_kl(old, ref) and sample_entropy(old) as token means over all responses of the update
decisions.stability_statistic: after the last optimizer step of the update: token mean of (rho - 1) - log rho, rho = pi_new / pi_old, on that update's tokens
decisions.explained_variance: 1 - Var(returns - values) / Var(returns) over valid tokens, values from before the update
decisions.non_finite: an optimizer step is skipped (and counted) when its loss or pre-clip grad norm is not finite

filter.rule: use a prompt only if len(apply_chat_template(messages, add_generation_prompt=True)) <= max_prompt_length; longer prompts are excluded, never truncated

prompts.sampler: torch.randperm over the kept prompts (file order) with torch.Generator(seed); first `updates` entries
